audited.name: Allgaeuer Kraftwerke GmbH
audited.result: Station-level AFIR/Mobilithek evidence materially narrows the unresolved estate without extrapolation. Am Alten Bahnhof 10A (DE*738*E00033*001/002, 50 kW CCS) is evidenced at 0.57 EUR/kWh, no start fee, blocking fee 0.06 EUR/min after 180 min. Sudetenstrasse 3 (2x 150 kW CCS) is evidenced at 0.66 EUR/kWh, no start fee, blocking fee 0.10 EUR/min after 45 min. Johann-Althaus-Strasse 3 has mixed 50/150 kW CCS and current Mobilithek-derived evidence shows 0.66 EUR/kWh on both connectors with no start fee and 0.10 EUR/min after 45 min, so nominal power alone is not a safe tariff-key shortcut. Current anonymous AC evidence remains 0.51 EUR/kWh at named AKW sites. The first-party AKW FAQ independently confirms ad-hoc credit-card access by QR. Operator-level discovery reports 25 stations / 67 charge points and is retained only as discovery evidence, not as a substitute for station-level proof.
audited.nextAction: Map the exact unresolved EVSE IDs against current Mobilithek/chargecloud or QR direct-payment records. Preserve per-station fee components and do not infer 0.57 vs 0.66 from nominal power alone.

audited.name: GEW Wilhelmshaven GmbH
audited.result: The net/gross correction from audit 002 is independently corroborated on another GEW ChargePoint station record: GEW WHV Station 02 exposes 0.44 EUR/kWh plus 19% VAT and card/app/RFID access. This strengthens the normalization rule but does not close the residual because the exact official-location mapping and zero-fee proof for every GEW location remain incomplete.
audited.nextAction: Keep 0.44 EUR/kWh as source-net, not final gross. Resolve the remaining official-location/EVSE mapping and confirm start/blocking fee fields before promotion.

audited.name: Stadtwerke Leipzig GmbH
audited.result: Fresh 2026 first-party material confirms registered L-Strom.drive prices are a separate product (0.54 EUR/kWh AC, 0.64 EUR/kWh DC regular). A current report citing Stadtwerke Leipzig states 2026 anonymous ad-hoc at 0.65 EUR/kWh AC and 0.75 EUR/kWh DC, consistent with the already-known ad-hoc values, but this does not establish EVSE coverage for the post-13.04.2024 subset. No registered tariff is substituted and no promotion is made.
audited.nextAction: Enumerate only post-13.04.2024 Stadtwerke Leipzig EVSEs and query their direct-payment records; do not reopen the legacy subset or substitute registered L-Strom.drive prices.

consistencyCheck.repeatInvestigationGuard: PASS: work stayed on unresolved station-level coverage; GEW and Leipzig completed price questions were not reopened.
consistencyCheck.materialProgress: Allgaeuer gained exact station-level energy and fee evidence for Am Alten Bahnhof 10A, Sudetenstrasse 3 and Johann-Althaus-Strasse 3 plus a critical anti-extrapolation finding for its mixed 50/150 kW site. Leipzig remains bounded to newer-EVSE coverage only.

nextSafeAction: Resolve exact remaining Allgaeuer EVSE identities against Mobilithek/chargecloud, then enumerate Leipzig post-13.04.2024 EVSEs. Keep GEW and Goettingen dormant until new fee-completeness evidence appears.
